tabs.html:
Cisco C1000-24P-4G-L 24 Port Gigabit PoE Switch

The Cisco C1000-24P-4G-L is a 24-port Gigabit PoE managed switch designed for modern enterprise networks, small to medium businesses, and ISPs in Bangladesh. Combining high-speed connectivity, advanced management features, and Power over Ethernet (PoE) capabilities, this switch ensures reliable network performance for IP phones, wireless access points, security cameras, and other networked devices.


With 4 Gigabit uplink ports, robust Layer 2 switching features, and energy-efficient design, the Cisco C1000-24P-4G-L offers a cost-effective solution for building secure, scalable, and manageable networks. Its intuitive web-based GUI and CLI management tools make network configuration simple for IT teams.


Technical Specifications:

Ports & Interfaces:

  • 24 x 10/100/1000 Mbps Gigabit Ethernet Ports
  • 4 x 1G Uplink Ports (1G SFP or 1G Copper)

Power over Ethernet (PoE):

  • Total PoE Budget: 195W
  • Supports IEEE 802.3af/at standards
  • Powers devices such as IP phones, access points, and cameras

Performance:

  • Switching Capacity: 56 Gbps
  • Forwarding Rate: 41.7 Mpps
  • MAC Address Table: 16K entries
  • VLANs: Up to 256 active VLANs
  • Jumbo Frames: 9216 bytes

Layer 2 Features:

  • VLAN Support: Port-based, 802.1Q Tagging
  • Link Aggregation: Static and LACP
  • Spanning Tree Protocol (STP/RSTP/MSTP)
  • QoS: 4 queues per port, 802.1p priority
  • Port Security and ACLs

Management & Security:

  • Management: Web-based GUI, CLI, SNMPv1/v2c/v3
  • DHCP Server/Client support
  • Security: Access Control Lists (ACLs), 802.1X Authentication

Physical & Environmental:

  • Rack-mountable (1U), compact design
  • Dimensions: 44.5 x 26 x 4.4 cm
  • Operating Temperature: 0°C to 45°C
  • Operating Humidity: 10% to 90% RH
  • Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE) support
